deploy-bot: Automated gates: PASS (latency/errors/health). Holding for manual approval window (10m) before promote.
mohit: Approving promote from my side. :thumbsup:

jamie: Approving.
mohit: Promote command ready: 
```
deployctl promote r-2026-03-20-3487654321 --to=stable --pin-tag v2.8.0 --reason "canary gated"
```

deploy-bot: Promotion started. Draining slice: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100% over 6 steps. Pinning tag `v2.8.0` to rollout.
releasenotes-bot: Draft release note generated: "Improve batching and KV cache management; reduces tail latency by ~5% and lowers per-token cost for short sequences." Review: https://docs.redwood/release/notes/draft/3487654321

ops-oncall: Verified autoscaler behavior during ramp — no unexpected replicas.
jamie: Posting short blurb to #release-notes after confirm.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete — 100% traffic on `v2.8.0` (commit `abc1234`). Rollout ID r-2026-03-20-3487654321 archived. If issues, run: `deployctl rollback r-2026-03-20-3487654321`.
sofia: Nice! :tada:
mohit: Will follow up with perf nugget in docs.
jamie: Closing the window — tagging release in repo and attaching notes. Thanks all. :rocket:
